source_name: GEMI — General Commercial Registry publicity portal (Γενικό Εμπορικό Μητρώο)
organization: Central Union of Chambers of Greece (KEEE) / Ministry of Development — Γενική Γραμματεία Εμπορίου
license: Public register (free to view); reuse terms unclear; no bulk redistribution implied
notes: Authoritative company register (Law 4919/2022). FREE manual web search by name/GEMI number/ΑΦΜ at businessportal.gr (EN) and publicity.businessportal.gr (EL). Underlying REST API at /api is UNDOCUMENTED, RATE-LIMITED (verified HTTP 429), and reCAPTCHA-protected (verified: recaptcha/api.js render token in page HTML) -> automated/bulk access blocked, do NOT bypass. No official open bulk export found. Recommended for MANUAL lookups; for automation see status blockers. Keyed on GEMI number + ΑΦΜ.

Companies must publish annual financial statements (οικονομικές καταστάσεις, under ΕΛΠ Greek GAAP or IFRS) and balance sheets (ισολογισμοί) to GEMI. They appear on the company's GEMI page as DOCUMENTS (PDF), not structured open data - no XBRL/CSV of figures. Structured financials require OCR/parsing or a commercial provider. Access via the company's GEMI page (same reCAPTCHA/portal constraints). Join on GEMI number / ΑΦΜ. Currency EUR.

source_name: AADE RgWsPublic — tax registry company basic data web service
organization: Ανεξάρτητη Αρχή Δημοσίων Εσόδων (AADE / Independent Authority for Public Revenue)
notes: AADE's RgWsPublic/RgWsPublic2 SOAP service returns company basic data by ΑΦΜ (name, address, ΚΑΔ activity, ΔΟΥ tax office, status). Verified endpoint reachable (HTTP 200) but REQUIRES registered TaxisNet web-service credentials (username/password issued by AADE). Not open bulk. Per-ΑΦΜ lookup. The authoritative tax-side complement to GEMI.
VIES validates a Greek VAT number (EL + the 9-digit ΑΦΜ). Verified reachable (HTTP 405 = needs SOAP POST). Validation/enrichment only; does not enumerate companies.

National open-data API (curated statistical datasets — e.g. crime, traffic, health, economy). Verified root reachable (HTTP 200); API requires a free token. It is NOT the company register and does NOT expose GEMI/company bulk. Discovery/context only.

Mandatory publication of government decisions/spending. Its open API exposes acts that often reference company ΑΦΜ + name (e.g. expenditure/award decisions). Not a company master, but a secondary cross-reference for company ΑΦΜ↔name and public-sector relationships. Open.

organization: Greek Government — Εθνικό Σύστημα Ηλεκτρονικών Δημοσίων Συμβάσεων
notes: Public procurement system (ΚΗΜΔΗΣ/ΕΣΗΔΗΣ) publishes contract notices/awards with supplier ΑΦΜ + name. Secondary company cross-reference for entities that bid for public contracts. Not a company master.

Vendors (ICAP/CRIF, Kyckr, etc.) resell GEMI register data + PARSED financial statements + credit data. The realistic path to STRUCTURED financials at scale (since GEMI financials are PDFs and the API is reCAPTCHA-protected). Proprietary, paid, per contract.
